answer: In this PoA design, every identity locks bonded collateral, and correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities incurs a penalty proportional to O(k^2), so a swarm costs more than independent faults. Once detected, an exponential multiplier applies to the swarm’s aggregate capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation limits recovery and discourages re-entry. A raven signal across the tundra or a whisper of coordination therefore carries real economic risk.
